name: Grand Walnut Dining Table
description: 10-seater solid walnut dining table with live-edge top, hand-oiled finish, and solid brass hairpin legs. Book-matched grain pattern. Designed for formal dining rooms in luxury residences.
custom_note: Seating capacity 8 to 14, leg style (hairpin, pedestal, or trestle), and edge profile customizable

name: Royal Oak Dining Set
description: 8-seater solid oak dining table with 8 matching upholstered chairs. Mortise-and-tenon joinery with herringbone base. Chairs feature hand-carved legs and premium linen upholstery.
custom_note: Chair upholstery fabric, table size, and finish fully customizable

name: Milan Oval Dining Table
description: 6-seater oval dining table in solid walnut with hand-inlaid brass banding along the top edge. Flared tapered legs with brass sabots. Contemporary luxury design inspired by Italian furniture houses.
custom_note: Brass or copper inlay options, leg profile selection, size adjustable for 4 to 8 seats

name: Chesterfield Leather Sofa Set
description: 5-seater Chesterfield sofa set in full-grain Italian leather with solid oak frame. Deep button-tufted back, rolled arms, hand-stitched piping. Solid oak ball-and-claw feet. Available in 8 leather colours.
custom_note: Leather type (full-grain or top-grain), leg style, and button colour customizable

name: Modular Sectional Sofa
description: 6-seater L-shape modular sectional sofa with solid walnut tapered legs. Premium Belgian linen upholstery with scatter-back cushions. Modular design allows rearrangement. Ideal for open-plan living spaces.
custom_note: Module count, left or right-hand orientation, fabric, and leg finish fully customizable

name: Classic Wing-Back Sofa
description: 3-seater wing-back sofa with hand-carved solid hardwood frame. Premium sprung seat, goose-down scatter cushions, and brocade fabric upholstery. A signature artisan piece with traditional European craftsmanship.
custom_note: Carving motif, fabric pattern, and frame finish customizable; 2-seater also available

name: Signature Bedroom Suite
description: Complete 5-piece master bedroom suite in solid walnut. King bed with upholstered headboard, pair of bedside tables, 6-drawer dresser with bronze hardware, and 4-door wardrobe with interior organiser. A signature collection for luxury master suites.
custom_note: Bed size (King or Queen), wardrobe internal layout, and hardware finish (bronze, brushed gold, or chrome) all customizable

name: Heritage Sleigh Bed
description: King-size sleigh bed in solid walnut with deeply curved headboard and matching footboard. Classic silhouette with contemporary proportions. Solid timber slat base. Pairs naturally with LUX-109 wardrobe for a complete suite.
custom_note: Queen size also available, headboard curve profile selectable, under-bed storage base option available

name: Grand Walk-In Wardrobe System
description: 6-door floor-to-ceiling walk-in wardrobe system in solid oak. Interior includes full-length hanging rail, double hanging sections, 16 adjustable shelves, 8 velvet-lined drawers, shoe rack for 40 pairs, and integrated LED strip lighting. Soft-close fittings throughout.
custom_note: Width, door count, interior layout, lighting, and handle style fully bespoke to room dimensions

name: Classic 4-Door Wardrobe
description: 4-door solid walnut wardrobe with two full-length mirror panels. Interior: hanging rail, 10 shelves, 4 velvet-lined drawers. Soft-close hinges and brushed brass bar handles. A refined standalone piece for guest suites and master bedrooms.
custom_note: Mirror panel placement, drawer count, and handle finish (brass, chrome, or matte black) customizable

name: Artisan Island Kitchen
description: Complete luxury kitchen in solid walnut with central island. Honed Calacatta marble countertops, integrated breakfast bar seating for 4, concealed drawer storage, and open display shelving. Solid brass hardware throughout. The flagship kitchen in our collection.
custom_note: Island dimensions, marble slab selection, appliance integration, and brass or gunmetal hardware all configurable

name: Gentleman's Dressing Cabinet
description: 2-door freestanding gentleman's dressing cabinet in solid walnut. Interior: pull-out tie rack, valet tray drawer, watch cushion insert, shoe tray, and short and full-length hanging sections. Slim footprint for dressing rooms and master suites.
custom_note: Interior accessories (watch trays, tie racks, shoe sections) configurable to order
